from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,sys,json,hashlib,re
S=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\Desktop\QASCP\public-review-20261125")
O=Path(r"C:\Users\manem\AppData\Local\Temp\qascp-re-audit-20261126-5919d022")
env=dict(os.environ,TEMP=str(O),TMP=str(O),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
runs=[]
for label,args in [("foundation",["scripts/verify_foundation.py"]),("lock",["scripts/verify_validation_lock.py"]),("checkout-tests",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_checkout_auth.py","-v"]),("lock-tests",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p","test_validation_lock.py","-v"]),("openapi",["scripts/verify_openapi_contracts.py"]),("full-unittest",["-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-v"])]:
 cmd=[sys.executable,"-B",*args];r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=S,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace")
 p=O/("08-local-"+label+".txt");p.write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr,encoding="utf-8")
 runs.append(dict(label=label,command=cmd,exit_code=r.returncode,output_file=p.name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
(O/"08-local-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
R=S/"docs/verification/reviews/P1/2026-11-26-5919d022b2fa"
m=json.loads((R/"manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"));checks=[]
for row in m["artifacts"]:
 e=json.loads((R/row["raw_envelope"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 raw=e["content"].encode("utf-8");digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
 item=dict(file=row["original"],hash_match=digest==row["sha256"]==e["original_utf8_sha256"],size_match=len(raw)==e["original_size_bytes"],scratch_original_match=(O/row["original"]).read_bytes()==raw)
 if row["original"] in ["01-security-architecture.md","02-bilingual-sources.md","03-organization-requirements.md","04-final-verification.md"]:
  norm=lambda x:"\n".join(line.rstrip() for line in x.replace("\r\n","\n").replace("\r","\n").splitlines())+"\n"
  item["normalized_display_match"]=norm((R/row["original"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))==norm(e["content"])
 checks.append(item)
risks=json.loads((S/"docs/governance/P1_RISK_OWNERSHIP.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["risks"]
c=dict(custody=checks,risk_count=len(risks),owners=[r["accountable_owner"] for r in risks],null_residual_ratings=sum(r["residual_risk"]["rating"] is None for r in risks),null_acceptance_refs=sum(r["risk_acceptance_reference"] is None for r in risks))
(O/"08-custody-risk-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(c,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(dict(runs=runs,custody_count=len(checks),custody_all_pass=all(all(v for k,v in r.items() if k!="file") for r in checks),null_residual_ratings=c["null_residual_ratings"],null_acceptance_refs=c["null_acceptance_refs"]),indent=2))
